description: Milestone timeline for the making-of trivai article. All dates verified against git history / project records on 2026-07-22. Suitable for a timeline strip graphic; 'act' maps each milestone to the article section it belongs to.

milestones.label: ai-trivia: first commit
milestones.detail: Prompt-only prototype. Playable that weekend, corny soundtrack included.

milestones.label: New repo
milestones.detail: trivai is born; an early commit is literally titled 'delete everything'.

milestones.label: Vector search begins
milestones.detail: Day two of the new repo. Retrieval as founding premise, not optimization.

milestones.label: First tests
milestones.detail: Vitest plus unit tests for token service, prompts, embeddings.

milestones.label: Multiplayer begins
milestones.detail: Pusher on Feb 1, working multiplayer on Feb 2. Quick and dirty client-relay design.

milestones.label: Wagering experiments
milestones.detail: Bet modals, bet increments; the mechanic later removed. Evidence of the design search.

milestones.label: Server-authoritative rewrite
milestones.detail: Pure reducer + transactional harness land in seven phases over one stretch.

milestones.label: Board reshuffle
milestones.detail: 6x6 compacts to 5x5, 4x4 as questions deplete; hand-built tile animation.

milestones.label: Traps / Wildcards
milestones.detail: The final missing mechanic. Secret off-turn placement, enforced by the engine.

milestones.label: Trivia Studio ships
milestones.detail: Player-built categories; forces the token economy refactor (1 flat -> 4 + 1 per AI category).

milestones.label: Generation perf fixes
milestones.detail: Cache pre-warming, reindexing, leaner fetches (generation versions v8/v9).
